coder_notes: Single-arm local radioligand therapy given at least 2 months after standard radiotherapy; chemotherapy 'may continue' at oncologist discretion so not listed and regimen coded monotherapy. Radionuclide omitted from the active moiety per W1 (225Ac in drug_class_hint). Tumour PK coded yes on the basis of quantitative SPECT/CT distribution imaging of the administered agent at the tumour site; this is imaging-based and may be judged differently. Mannitol and dexamethasone are listed as pre-treatment medication given to every patient; purpose not stated, coded supportive (mannitol is not stated as BBB opening). Eligibility is diffuse glioma G3-G4 with glioblastoma named in conditions.
